I've encountered that there was a spammer problem at /v/news and that the spammers might be the reason why the registrations are on 'invite only'. Because of this I thought this would be the time to think of some countermeasures. So I came up with some ideas for voat (shocking I know).

First of all I want to make clear that most of the ideas that follow are only reasonable on bigger subverses as most/all of them require a mod that is available for making short, but immediate response.

Accounts should have a maximum amount of posts/time

I would say an amount of 5 posts per 5 minutes would be a appropriate, but I assume the amount of posts, as well as the period should be variable per subverse, as some mods might have different conception, regarding postlimits. This would ensure that mods can ban a user before such a user can flood a subverse with spam. Mods should be able to remove those limits from specific users, if these have a legit reason to get whitelisted.

An automated message to the mods if a user reaches the limit of posts/time

These should include the topic of there posts, obviously the username with a link and maybe how many posts the user already has submitted. This would help the mods keeping the oversight on users that may post spam and can maybe even decide on whether the user is a spammer or a legit one. This not only makes it easier to ban users, but also to find users to whitelist. I would highly recommend a special tag on these automated messages so a mod can filter them out if he gets spammed with such messages. Also this would make it easier to search their history for repeated submitting of many threads.

An automated message if an users thread(s) are getting downvoated a lot

As downvoats are meant to state that this post is low quality, I assume this would be helpful. Downvoats are already rare because of the 100 ccp rule, so they are not often used. So if a post has many of them it's likely that users see it as spam (or equallly bad / even worse). I have a message in mind, with a link to the user, the post that was the reason for the message and the amount of upvoats/downvoats + the amount of already submitted posts (as a reference to him being a regular poster or it being likely to be a spammer account).

I know these ideas are rather informing a mod, as making it harder to create spam, but I assume it would still help blocking them. I also want to state that I have not enough knowledge of programming that I could immagine how much work @Atko and @PuttItOut would have to do to implement these features. Still I hope this helps for developing voat, or at least inspire someone to come up with some ideas that are helping voat to become a better place.
